prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Preview Grid: Redesign the pet selection screen into a grid layout with live animated pet previews to give users clear visual expectations before adopting. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (60.9% conversion, median 89s) and users reported custom pet results looking wrong.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Check Screen: Insert a custom pet preview verification screen right after photo upload so users can adjust visual settings before confirming adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals during adoption.)
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Sandbox Onboarding: Redesign the home intro step into a hands-on interactive sandbox card where users test dragging, hiding, and interacting with their pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion about how to control or hide the pet, and 4 reported desktop feature issues post-onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-Onboarding Path Overview Screen: Add an initial onboarding roadmap screen that breaks down the path choices and estimated pet creation time before starting. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean time of 514s indicating user hesitation.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Progress and Tips: Display explicit progress indicators and overlay setup hints on the waiting screen while desktop rendering initializes. (why: Home step target waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s) and users reported pets not showing up.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Path Benefit Split Comparison: Change choose_path screen layout to a split view contrasting quick adoption against custom pet creation. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with an average time of 514s.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts and a tip carousel while waiting for background launch tasks to complete. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting for load completion.)

scores.note: Addresses the adoption step, which has the highest drop-off rate (39.1%), backed by user complaints.
Fixes custom pet visual failures at adoption step, but adding a new screen adds step friction.
Targets the finish step (35.2% drop-off) where multiple support emails report confusion.
Addresses hesitation time on choose_path, but adding a new screen may increase friction.
Directly targets massive mean wait time (2336s) and missing pet reports on home step.
Improves path selection clarity to reduce 514s delay, though drop-off is relatively low.
Helps re-engage users who minimize the app during long home screen rendering times.
